title: Nvidia prepays Amkor to expand advanced packaging in Arizona and South Korea

sources.quote: NVIDIA is supporting Amkor's expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totaling nearly $3 billion.

explain: Nvidia is funding Amkor's packaging expansion in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements, including prepayments. Nvidia says they total 'nearly $3 billion', so the amount is an approximation.
